checklist.detail: Record PSA/date, gland volume, prior biopsy and relevant treatment.

checklist.label: Zonal anatomy
checklist.detail: Locate each lesion by zone, side, level and sector.

checklist.label: Scoring
checklist.detail: Use DWI as dominant in peripheral zone and T2 in transition zone with v2.1 adjustment rules.

checklist.label: Local extension
checklist.detail: Assess capsule, neurovascular bundles, seminal vesicles and adjacent organs.

checklist.label: Beyond gland
checklist.detail: Review pelvic nodes and imaged bones, acknowledging their assessment limits.

measurements.name: Gland volume and PSA density
measurements.method: Use ellipsoid AP×transverse×longitudinal×0.52 in cm or segmentation; PSA density=PSA/volume.
measurements.pitfall: Record the PSA date and volume method; density is not a PI-RADS scoring input.

measurements.name: Lesion dimension
measurements.method: Measure largest dimension on ADC for PZ or T2 for TZ where adequately defined; record plane/sequence.
measurements.pitfall: DWI score 5 needs the specified ≥1.5 cm size or definite invasive behaviour criterion.

measurements.name: Capsular contact
measurements.method: Record contact length and direct extension findings separately.
measurements.pitfall: Contact length alone does not prove extraprostatic extension.

classification.name: PI-RADS
classification.applicability: Detection and localisation of clinically significant prostate cancer in the untreated prostate using an adequate examination.
classification.summary: Use the zone-specific dominant sequence and published adjustment rules. The category expresses suspicion, separately from PSA density, stage and management.

pitfalls: Prostatitis, BPH nodules and haemorrhage can imitate cancer.
PI-RADS v2.1 is not the post-treatment recurrence scoring system.
impression_prompts: State index lesion number, sector and PI-RADS category.
Summarise local extension and pelvic findings separately from suspicion score.
Record gland volume, PSA density when available and material image-quality limits.
